notes:
Passed on the fake backend with evidence contract_checked (never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wD-029) and unreviewed: reviewed_by is null, no hardware was attached, and neither a hardware backend nor an upstream simulator was run. The gate never imports the clone or the upstream package; the real environment needs Isaac Sim 5.1.0 (setup.sh:339) on an NVIDIA RTX 2070+ GPU with 8GB+ VRAM (docs/getting_started/installation.md:9-10), so the fake backend is the package's own reduced pure-Python stand-in for omnigibson.envs.env_base:Environment and was never compared with the upstream environment. The fake models one robot with two position-controlled joints and proprioception only: its joint count, control bounds and reset pose are placeholders (marked in fake.py), not the robot's real control limits. Upstream action_space is a Dict of robot name to robot action space (env_base.py:429) and observation_space a Dict of robot, task and sensor spaces (env_base.py:386-423); the real dimensions depend on the scene and robot configuration and are not stated in the clone. The fake returns one environment's observation and scalar reward and flags, while upstream step returns per-environment lists and tensors (env_base.py:807) and reset an observation list (env_base.py:903). NOT COVERED: the scene, objects, contacts, physics, actuators, sensors and images; the full action and observation spaces; rendering; snapshot and restore (no get_state/set_state); a seeded or deterministic run (upstream reset declares no seed parameter, env_base.py:838, so the bridge's cap.world.seed.v1 value is stored but never read, and the fidelity declares determinism none); the upstream install and the Isaac Sim path. The card's mock_strategy.preferred upstream-sim was not used: OmniGibson registers no environment with gymnasium.make and needs Isaac Sim, so env_id is unset and the package fake is the only backend this package serves; that upstream path was not run. The card's GymnasiumDriver shape fits the interface, so there is no deviation from the card, and only catalogue classes (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1) are bound, so there are no catalogue requests. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge stores the seed for the next reset and makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer seed of the reset and seed classes, ticks, and the numeric action.robot[*] element (the bridge derives these from the class/family schema and the fake's space and gives them no unit); there were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. The clone was not modified, imported or run. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run.
